statement: The four- and five-vortex expansions have, besides the double eigenvalue 0, only eigenvalues with real part -1 or -2.
In one naive sample, 52 of 342 four-vortex collapses and 32 of 543 five-vortex collapses reverse into linearly stable expansions. Not checked for duplicates.
Kallyadan and Shukla (2022) was read as an abstract only.
The published CMP text of Zbarsky (2021) was not compared with the arXiv version the proofs cite.
